title: Collectibles
description: Goddess chests, heart pieces, loose gratitude crystals and every other chest, ticked when collected or opened. Location names and chest IDs from the Skyward Sword Randomizer (MIT); flag positions from its Archipelago world, checked against a 100% Wii save. Hover an entry to see whether it was verified.
